source.citation: C. Cayron, The Correspondence Theory and Its Application to NiTi Shape Memory Alloys, Crystals 12 (2022) 130.

blind_protocol: Only the already-locked B2/B19prime metrics, symmetries and base correspondence are exposed. The code must identify non-classical higher-order operator classes, derive the rational invariant axis and intercorrespondence, then discover weak planes. Expected planes and weak-twin observables are hidden until comparison.

protocol.operator_selection: Build exact CT correspondence groupoid from base benchmark input; exclude identity and all double cosets containing an exact Type-I mirror or Type-II proper twofold; analyze remaining proper crystallographic 3/4/6-fold elements.

weak_plane_search.ranking: metric-native intrinsic in-plane distortion; no expected plane supplied

lock.mutation_policy: immutable_v1; source correction requires new benchmark version
